# Planches animées — ImageGen intégré

Neuf personnages, planches de 4 × 4 poses, génération intégrée avec fond transparent. Les anciennes images restent conservées dans le dossier parent.

## player

Création à partir de la description.

```text
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FUNCTIONAL ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for an actual 2D top-down RPG, not an illustration board.
Create EXACTLY 16 full-body pixel-art sprites of ONE SAME CHARACTER in a strict, regular 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS grid filling a square canvas. Equal-sized cells. One sprite centered in each cell, with generous TRANSPARENT gutters. Consistent pixel density, body size, hairstyle, face, clothing and camera in every frame. Orthographic slightly overhead top-down JRPG view, crown of head visible, about 3 heads tall, refined pixel clusters and colored shadows, clear 1-pixel outline. No perspective environment. Characters walk IN PLACE without translation across their cells.
ROW 1: facing DOWN toward viewer, four visibly different phases of walking.
ROW 2: facing LEFT, four visibly different phases of walking.
ROW 3: facing RIGHT, four visibly different phases of walking.
ROW 4: facing UP away from viewer, four visibly different phases of walking.
In EVERY row, COLUMN 1 = left foot forward and right arm forward (contact), COLUMN 2 = feet passing beneath torso, COLUMN 3 = right foot forward and left arm forward (opposite contact), COLUMN 4 = passing stance toward the next left contact. Make the two strides unmistakably different, legs and arms changing. Preserve the SAME head and torso size across all 16 frames. Keep heads level, footsteps at a common cell baseline. No standing duplicates in all columns.
Background genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA; NO black/white backdrop, NO glow, NO floor, NO shadow, NO text, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO borders, NO scene, NO portraits, NO overlapping sprites, no cropped limbs. Only sixteen isolated animated sprites.
Style: richly shaded premium school JRPG pixel art, elegant clear silhouettes, controlled burgundy / navy / ivory / champagne palette. Small game sprite design, not giant anime heads.
Character identity: Original male player student, short layered medium brown hair, amber eyes, burgundy blazer with gold edging, navy tie, navy trousers, black loafers.
```
